threshold_mapping: Binary scale per dimension: 1 = the check PASSes, 0 = it does not. pass = mean >= T_accept(1) AND min >= T_dim(1), i.e. every check PASS. Any 0 with iterations < cap -> regenerate; at cap -> needs_owner. T_reject 0 means the algebra never rejects. k = 2 iteration bound (= cap); x = 10 (% of budget) B.1.2 discovery window; x is NOT a spend allowance — the budget stays strictly < US$0.15.
